Display.multi_display: Arrow Lake up to 4; Lunar Lake up to 3 independent displays

display_options: 14" WUXGA (1920x1200) IPS 500nits on-cell touch, 100% sRGB, Privacy Guard, 60Hz
14" 2.8K (2880x1800) OLED 500nits add-on film touch, 100% DCI-P3, 120Hz VRR

storage.ssd_pcie: One M.2 2280 PCIe NVMe SSD, up to 1TB; PCIe 4.0 x4 on U-series and PCIe 5.0 x4 on V/H-series

Ethernet: No onboard Ethernet; supported through USB-C adapter

Bluetooth.form: Integrated in Wi-Fi + Bluetooth combo adapter

SIM_Card.type: Nano-SIM slot on selected WWAN models

ports: 2 x Thunderbolt 4 / USB4 with USB PD and DisplayPort 2.1
audio: HD Audio, Realtek ALC3287 codec, stereo speakers 2W x2, Dolby Atmos, dual microphone array
keyboard: 6-row spill-resistant keyboard with Copilot key, LED backlight
TrackPoint and glass-like Mylar multi-touch trackpad

physical.weight: Starting at 1.24 kg with Arrow Lake; 1.28 kg with Lunar Lake
physical.case_material: Carbon fiber hybrid or aluminium top, aluminium bottom

security: Discrete TPM 2.0 and Microsoft Pluton TPM 2.0 on Lunar Lake
